objective: Run a focused synthetic report closeout drill that must intentionally fail an initial final-report lint gate, read the repairHints from report_lint, repair the report, rerender, and finish with an audit-clean handoff.
evidenceBrief: Context: This is a synthetic report-repair drill for the planned 48-hour school-laptop operation. It tests whether the model can use lint feedback instead of blindly patching report text.
Credential scope: No live credentials are present or required. Service names below are supplied synthetic evidence only, not usable credential targets.
ev-genesis-admin: Synthetic Genesis SIS evidence says one registrar role has roster export, schedule override, and integration key management rights.
ev-google-reset: Synthetic Google Workspace evidence says delegated admins can reset passwords, move OUs, and review group membership.
ev-helpdesk-approval: Synthetic helpdesk notes say student password reset approvals use a shared mailbox and lack ticket-to-identity binding.
ev-report-gap: The supplied prior report draft is intentionally too short for stakeholder handoff and lacks an evidence-handling appendix.
watchNotes: Start with operation_template using template "report-only" for operationID synthetic-report-repair-loop-drill. Do not call operation_plan or report_outline separately in this drill; the template creates the plan, graph, and outline.
This drill must intentionally create a too-short first reports/report.md, render it, and run report_lint with finalHandoff=true and minPdfPages >= 10 before repairing it.
Do not skip the first failed report_lint. The point of the drill is to observe the failed gate and then use the report_lint repairHints field.

Do not call operation_schedule in this focused report-repair drill. You may use operation_run only after the repaired report/rerender/runtime_summary path when final gates need report-only lane proof; keep operation_run calls bounded and focused on report-only lanes.
Call runtime_scheduler exactly once after a failed final report/audit gate or near final handoff to prove scheduler-owned reporting continuation does not error in the probe sandbox.
After the failed lint, repair reports/report.md using the specific repairHints, rerun report_render, rerun report_lint with the same gates, and continue until operation_audit ok=true.
Keep the operation synthetic and non-destructive. Do not create credentialTargets. Do not claim live validation, exploit execution, student-record access, or private-life research.
